notes: Saved 2026-11-14 (Hong Kong) through createFetcher (fixture request 1 of 8, .superpowers/raw-pages/charming/ledger-fixtures.tsv), trimmed with the allow list in docs/operators/charming.md. An old post: the REST list gives it as modified 2023-11-29.

What an expired tour page looks like: still HTTP 200, the full page, with its old date in the table (30/11/2023), here marked FU (`額滿`, full) in two places. The parser drops the full date, so departures is []; normaliseTour skips the tour as no-departures (not a failure). Were the date not full, normaliseTour would drop it as past.
This is the only FU row seen: the status class `reservation-table-status FU`, the date cell's status empty and the booking cell's saying `額滿`.
No early-booking discount on this page: the adult price is only in .detail-discount-price (9998). The tax (633) is shown separately and not added.
The last label is `Day 5/6` (a night flight): five headings for six days; the days come from the title's `6天`.

normalised is no-departures, so stopNames is extractStops over the day headings (Hong Kong excluded), not normaliseTour's route: 杜拜, 阿布扎比, 杜拜. `阿布達比` (Abu Dhabi) was added as an alias of 阿布扎比 in the EGL review round (2026-11-14); it also gives `阿布達比大清真寺`, so neither is reported unmatched any more. Before, the route was 杜拜 only.
Unmatched names are normaliseTour's, which it reports even for a tour it skips.
